basis: Both reserved 128-fight Java panels gave lower mean squared scoring error under the native queue. Independent-phase errors changed from 0.128939 to about 0.1137 on A and 0.130050 to about 0.1236 on B. The 128 B predictions committed in advance improved from 0.13005 to 0.12382. The stock 26.3 server drains this queue before its world tick.
applicability: Use the tick queue for variable and mixed-phase training, selections, counter searches and nominations from this season. Preserve the exact scheduled kernel and the original continuous-delivery code for reproducing prior seasons. Actual Java determines promotion.
sample_control: A matched W-tap arm used the same timing in each comparison. No recorded evaluation calendar, opponent action tape, or native hit label is a training input.
